links.outcome: TB AI sensitivity/specificity vs ten radiologists on same CXRs
links.effect: High-sensitivity threshold: AI 87% sens/70% spec vs radiologists 76%/82%; noninferior for sensitivity (P<0.001), not specificity (P=0.99). Balanced threshold 78%/82%, comparable to radiologists.
links.quote: At the high-sensitivity threshold, the TB AI was noninferior to average radiologist sensitivity (P<0.001) but not to average radiologist specificity (P=0.99) and was higher than the WHO target for specificity but not sensitivity.

links.outcome: TB AI sensitivity and specificity compared with radiologists
links.effect: High-sensitivity TB AI: sensitivity 87%, specificity 70%; radiologists: 76%, 82%. Noninferior for sensitivity (P<0.001), not specificity (P=0.99). Balanced-threshold AI: sensitivity 78%, specificity 82%, comparable to radiologists.
links.quote: At the high-sensitivity threshold, the TB AI was noninferior to average radiologist sensitivity (P<0.001) but not to average radiologist specificity (P=0.99) and was higher than the WHO target for specificity but not sensitivity.

links.effect: The TB AI failed to meet prespecified WHO sensitivity recommendations in the study population.
links.quote: Neither the TB AI nor the radiologists met WHO recommendations for sensitivity in the study population.

links.effect: At the balanced threshold, the TB AI performed comparably to the reading radiologists.
links.quote: At the balanced threshold, the TB AI was comparable to radiologists.

screen.practice: alert threshold selection (high-sensitivity vs balanced threshold) in prospective local validation
screen.reason: Prospective multi-site validation/reader study evaluating the diagnostic performance (sensitivity and specificity) of two cloud-based chest X-ray AI systems against radiologists and WHO benchmark targets; it does not evaluate an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
